description: This file defines theme hooks and preprocessing functions for the Drupal file module, including rendering of file links, upload help, and multi-file widgets.

classes.name: FileThemeHooks
classes.description: Defines theme hooks and preprocessing functions for the Drupal file module, including rendering of file links, upload help, and multi-file widgets.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hooks for various file-related templates and elements.

methods.name: preprocessFileLink
methods.description: Prepares variables for rendering a file link, including URL, classes, and size.

methods.name: preprocessFileUploadHelp
methods.description: Prepares variables for upload help text, including size limits, allowed types, and image dimensions.

methods.name: preprocessManagedFile
methods.description: Prepares variables for the managed file form element, setting attributes.

methods.name: preprocessFileWidgetMultiple
methods.description: Prepares variables for rendering a multi-file widget with drag-and-drop and ordering.
